blocks.text: You can customize the landmine installer, modify the lure refresh interval, and enable auto clean-up of duplicate agents from the Agent Configuration page.
Agent Configuration provides the following benefits and enables you to:

blocks.item: Customize landmine agent properties such as name, display name, and description to prevent the agents from being fingerprinted.
Modify the refresh interval to automatically update lure information.

blocks.text: On the Agent Configuration page (Settings > Endpoint Settings > Agent Configuration), you can do the following:

blocks.item: Customize the landmine agent installer properties.
Enable auto clean-up of duplicate agents.
